description: Start a job to create sound for an owned gallery video. First call chargen_quote_video_to_audio, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Spends the quoted Gold; returns request_id to poll with chargen_get_job. Only the declared settings are supported. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

duration_seconds.description: Audio duration in seconds, where supported.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

model.description: Enabled audio model supporting video-to-audio; chargen_list_media_models can help choose a model. This never changes the operation.

negative_prompt.description: Things to keep out of the result, as a short list. Only some models take one: chargen_list_media_models shows negative_prompt in that model's settings, and any other model refuses this argument.

prompt.description: The sounds to add to the video. Optional when the chosen model supports video-derived sound without text; otherwise required.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_video_to_audio. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

video_id.description: Owned gallery video UUID to edit, follow or add sound to.

name: chargen_generate_video_to_audio
title: Start video to audio
